notes: Page 81 verified. Abba Macarius (መቃርስ ዘይሴሰይ ቈቃሐ): hermit trapping one partridge daily, avoiding worldly speech/slander; monk from Constantinople reporting him to the Patriarch; miracle of three partridges caught in one snare just as visitors arrive.
